title: New v1.1.0 Update - AI Data Center Tycoon
author: PurpleJelly_Custom
selftext:
Update just went live for my browser idle game about growing an AI from a garage rig into a hyperscaler.

\- **Saves**. Your run autosaves every 10 seconds and on tab close, so a refresh no longer wipes it. There's also an export/import code in the settings dock for backups or moving a run to another device.

\- **Sound**. 28 sound effects covering clicks, purchases, milestones and era transitions, with a five-category mixer so you can mute whatever gets annoying. Ambience and ops chatter are off by default.

\- **Mobile**. The operator console reflows properly on phones and tablets now instead of forcing you to pinch-zoom.
